source.name: California CDSS Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly
source.sourceDescription: Public open-data table for California Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly.
parsingNotes: CKAN datastore records are paginated with offset/limit against the resource ID.
Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly are treated as assisted living facilities.
Facility number is preserved as source_facility_id and used for stable facility_key generation.
The source does not currently expose latitude/longitude, so distance fields remain null until geocoding is added.
Licensee, administrator, status, license dates, regional office, and file date are preserved as source-supplied fields.
Records are sorted by facility name, then source facility ID, before applying the limit.
